_governance.reason: PR 门禁耗时预算只减不增；放宽预算等于无声接受构建变慢
_governance.expires_when: 预算随分片与缓存优化整体下调时重新采样替换
_governance.measure: 按 gate 声明 budgetSeconds / hardFailSeconds 与关键路径构成；实际执行耗时超过 hardFailSeconds 即失败，超过 budgetSeconds 记 over_budget。

prod-hosted.notes: prod-hosted currently remains gray rollout stage driven via stackctl deploy --target prod-hosted with service/image/config/step/SLO inputs; do not infer restart|rollout|cold-build commands for prod.

01.local_env_matrix.criticalPath: L0 + alpha + beta + gamma + prod(package/purity/release-verify) serial; exclusive local runtime switch
01.local_env_matrix.cacheModeNotes: warm soft=600s; cold may use hard=1800s or COLD_CACHE_EXEMPT then require a warm re-run. prod-hosted SSH deploy is NOT in this budget.

02.service_pipeline.criticalPath: workflow run created_at -> candidate completed_at, including queue and setup waits

03.delivery_gate.criticalPath: workflow run created_at -> candidate evidence completed_at, including queue and setup waits

05.app_env_device_matrix_pr.criticalPath: workflow run created_at -> device evidence aggregation completed_at, including queue and setup waits

07.mainline_auto_prod.criticalPath: workflow run created_at -> Prod full verification completed_at, including queue, setup and official approval waits
07.mainline_auto_prod.machinePath: source_context + max(service_pipeline, app_pipeline, delivery_gate) + prepare + max(alpha_stage, beta_device_matrix, gamma_local) + preprod_evidence + prod_rollout_transaction
